coreServiceDescription: Hive stores Wiki pages, structured objects and files, and connects hosts, service resources and events.

coreGroups.wiki: Search, browse, read and edit Wiki pages using page-specific tools.
coreGroups.objects: Generic object storage fallback; prefer dedicated Wiki or service tools when available.
coreGroups.hostConfigurations: Stored host settings, service configuration and revision history.
coreGroups.settings: Hive-wide settings, including quiet hours for automatic contact.
coreGroups.serviceNodes: Service instances, status and required schemas.
coreGroups.inventory: Resources advertised by services and their owning hosts.
coreGroups.topics: Discover service events available as subscription triggers.
coreGroups.system: Hive status, caller identity and diagnostics.
coreGroups.retention: Storage retention policies and eligible data.
coreGroups.deployments: Service deployment status and original operations.

coreGuide: Use wiki_search and wiki_read for Wiki pages and the publishing service’s direct tools for its functions. Generic Hive object operations cover data without a dedicated tool. Use hive.objects.list or tree to browse a hierarchy. For structured service data, discover its contract with hive.contracts.list/get and filter fields with hive.objects.query. Find resource owners with hive.inventory.list or hive.serviceNodes.list; discover subscribable events with hive.topics.list. Read before editing, use the current expectedRevision and retain mutationId for the same change. Reconcile an unknown outcome before retrying.

coreDescriptions.wiki.search: Search Wiki page titles and Markdown. Optionally search below a page or include archived pages.
coreDescriptions.wiki.list: List Wiki pages directly below a parent; omit parentId to browse root pages.
coreDescriptions.wiki.read: Read a Wiki page and its revision, optionally at a historical revision.
coreDescriptions.wiki.create: Create a Wiki page with a title and Markdown under an optional parent. Retain mutationId for retries.
coreDescriptions.wiki.update: Replace a Wiki page’s Markdown using its current expectedRevision. Read first and retain mutationId for retries.
coreDescriptions.wiki.history: List the saved revisions of a Wiki page.
coreDescriptions.wiki.move: Move or rename a Wiki page using its exact objectId, parentId, name and a stable mutationId.
coreDescriptions.wiki.archive: Archive or restore a Wiki page using archived=true or false and a stable mutationId.
coreDescriptions.system.status: Read Hive readiness, version and current caller identity.
coreDescriptions.openai.getConfiguration: Read the saved OpenAI app ID and revision for this Hive.
coreDescriptions.settings.get: Read Hive-wide settings and their current revision. Quiet hours apply without optional services.
coreDescriptions.settings.save: Save Hive-wide settings at expectedRevision. Use zero for the first save and retain mutationId to reconcile a lost response.
coreDescriptions.openai.saveConfiguration: Save or clear the OpenAI app ID at its current expectedRevision; use zero for the first save and retain mutationId for retries.
coreDescriptions.system.instructions: Read the complete current MCP instructions or tested workflow examples, with a hash and continuation when needed.
coreDescriptions.system.toolSchema: Read the exact public MCP input and output schemas for one named tool.
coreDescriptions.system.inspectStorage: Inspect stored contract versions and storage compatibility.
coreDescriptions.system.diagnostics: List current or historical service diagnostics.
coreDescriptions.contracts.list: List object schemas (data contracts) and their versions.
coreDescriptions.contracts.summaries: List compact data contract summaries; use hive_schema_get for the complete schema and guidance.
coreDescriptions.contracts.get: Read a data contract, its schema and usage guidance.
coreDescriptions.contracts.register: Register an agent-owned data contract using a stable mutationId.
coreDescriptions.contracts.validate: Validate content against an exact contract version.
coreDescriptions.objects.stat: Read metadata for a Wiki page, structured object or file by ID or path.
coreDescriptions.objects.read: Read a Wiki page, structured object or file, optionally at a saved revision.
coreDescriptions.objects.write: Create or update a Wiki page, structured object or file. Updates require expectedRevision; retain mutationId for retries.
coreDescriptions.objects.history: List saved revisions of a Wiki page, structured object or file.
coreDescriptions.objects.list: List Wiki pages, structured objects and files under a parent.
coreDescriptions.objects.tree: Browse a hierarchy of Wiki pages, structured objects and files.
coreDescriptions.objects.query: Find structured objects by contract and field filters, such as tasks or assignments.
coreDescriptions.objects.search: Find Wiki pages, documents and files by text. Use objects.query for structured field filters.
coreDescriptions.objects.move: Move or rename a stored document or file.
coreDescriptions.objects.reorder: Reorder a stored document or file within its current parent.
coreDescriptions.objects.archive: Archive or restore an object using archived=true or false and a stable mutationId.
coreDescriptions.objects.delete: Permanently delete a Wiki page or TaskBoard task and its stored revisions.
coreDescriptions.retention.preview: Preview current retention eligibility without deleting data.
coreDescriptions.retention.status: Read effective family policies, eligible volume and bounded journal usage.
coreDescriptions.hosts.list: List connected hosts and their service instances.
coreDescriptions.hosts.observations: Read reported host configuration and runtime observations.
coreDescriptions.hostConfigurations.list: List stored host configuration summaries and revisions.
coreDescriptions.hostConfigurations.get: Read a complete stored host configuration. Use hostConfigurations.edit for a view with secrets redacted.
coreDescriptions.hostConfigurations.put: Store a complete host configuration at its current revision. Use hostConfigurations.save to preserve redacted secrets.
coreDescriptions.hostConfigurations.edit: Read a host configuration for editing, with secrets redacted. This call does not change it.
coreDescriptions.hostConfigurations.save: Save an edited host configuration at its current revision, preserving unchanged redacted secrets.
coreDescriptions.hostConfigurations.history: List saved revisions of a host configuration.
coreDescriptions.serviceNodes.list: Find service instances by host or service name.
coreDescriptions.serviceNodes.get: Read status and identity of one exact service instance.
coreDescriptions.serviceNodes.contracts: Read data contracts required by a service instance.
coreDescriptions.inventory.list: Find resources advertised by services and their original owners.
coreDescriptions.inventory.get: Read one advertised resource and its observation freshness.
coreDescriptions.events.read: Read a bounded event batch after a sequence number.
coreDescriptions.topics.list: Find registered event triggers, including Hive object changes, with payload schemas and event kinds.
coreDescriptions.packages.catalog: List available service and application packages, optionally after a catalog revision.
coreDescriptions.packages.authorizeUpload: Create a five-minute, single-use upload token for one validated package identity.
coreDescriptions.uis.list: Read complete published application records; prefer uis.catalog for a compact overview.
coreDescriptions.uis.get: Read one published application and its releases.
coreDescriptions.uis.catalog: List installed application metadata and selected releases.
coreDescriptions.uis.releases: List compact release summaries for an application.
coreDescriptions.uis.inspect: Check an application release and its dependencies.
coreDescriptions.uis.deploy: Publish and select an application release with a stable mutationId.
coreDescriptions.uis.rollback: Select a previous application release with a stable mutationId.
coreDescriptions.deployments.get: Read the original deployment operation on its host.
